title: All-moduli Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.87338196661320751993
description: Proves Dirichlet nonvanishing for every positive modulus and character when Re(s) > 87338196661320751993/100000000000000000000, excluding only the principal pole. Tightens the reserve-parametric fourth-power seed and selected-energy gap to 10^-22 (matching the row fee and transport step), supplying two finite source lines and a complete five-window return within 10^-20 of the limiting contact (777 - sqrt(1081))/852. The final theorem has no analytic or source-provider premise. Builds on Joseph Bebel (PR93, PR98, PR99), ArviFoxy (PR97), Jacob Sussman, Sil, Hailey Collet and OpenAI. Inherited notices and licenses are retained. The development was AI-assisted.
